rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: The vessel built to carry life through the flood
content.ART_PROMPT: A vast hull of gopher wood ribs rising on a bare hillside, pitch smoking in an iron cauldron, curls of shaved wood trodden into the mud, no people, luminous cinematic oil painting with impressionistic brushwork, saturated full colour, a strong symbolic subject, no engraving or line art, overcast grey-blue daylight, soft and shadowless, wet colours saturated
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Choose up to three cards in Sheol whose card type is in the Chapter Lot and add those chosen cards to your hand. If the cards in your Pages have total LORE fifteen or more, draw one card from the Tower.
content.OT_VERSE_SNIPPET: Make thee an ark of gopher wood ... and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch
content.NT_VERSE_SNIPPET: prepared an ark to the saving of his house
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Genesis 6:14 — “Make thee an ark of gopher wood ... and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: Hebrews 11:7 — “prepared an ark to the saving of his house”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: The same word carries Moses down the Nile in a basket of bulrushes daubed with pitch - two rescues by water in one vocabulary.
The ark has no rudder, no sail and no oars; it is described as a floating chest, and the LORD shuts the door.
Greek uses kibotos for Noah's ark and for the ark of the covenant alike; Hebrew keeps them apart as tebah and aron.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left).
